instrument: Four items on attitudes to abortion from the 1986 British Social Attitudes Survey (McGrath & Waterton, 1986), distributed as the Abortion data set in the ltm R package (CRAN, GPL-2+). Item wording, the shared stem and the source are the package's own man page, ?Abortion; the item codes item_1..item_4 are the data frame's own columns 'Item 1'..'Item 4'. See also Knott, Albanese & Galbraith (1990), 'Scoring attitudes to abortion', The Statistician 40:217-223.
instructions: The law should allow abortion under the circumstances presented under each item.
